subject.title: [Feature] Configurable thinking/reasoning block format per channel

question: Should visible reasoning presentation be a portable agent-level contract, a channel-owned setting, or a portable default with channel overrides?
rationale: The change adds public configuration across core and multiple bundled plugins, while formats such as spoiler have channel-specific semantics; repository behavior cannot determine the permanent ownership and precedence without maintainer intent.

options.title: Portable default plus overrides
options.body: Add a distinctly named portable presentation enum with documented channel override precedence and capability mapping.

options.title: Channel-owned presentation
options.body: Keep presentation entirely in each channel plugin and do not add an agent-level setting.

options.title: Keep fixed presentation
options.body: Retain the current built-in italic output and decline additional configuration surface.

recommendation.title: Portable default plus overrides
recommendation.body: Add a distinctly named portable presentation enum with documented channel override precedence and capability mapping.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior issue review and recent central reasoning-path commits make steipete the strongest available owner for the cross-core/channel product choice.
